dedupe_note: This file only extends the existing full-catalog affiliate audit. Existing individual task/application results take precedence over generic web research, and no application is created by this audit increment.

tools.evidence_summary: The current official Copy.ai site/search surface did not expose an active affiliate enrollment route, and the previously plausible official /affiliate-program route returns 404. Copy.ai still publishes general affiliate-marketing educational content, but that is not evidence that its own affiliate program is currently open. Historical or third-party commission claims are therefore not used to mark this program active.

tools.commission: 30% on paid referrals; monthly plans earn recurring commission for up to 12 months, while annual plans pay a one-time commission at signup
tools.payout_terms: Monthly payouts via PayPal, Wise, or local bank transfer; $25 minimum payout. Refunds within 60 days claw back the corresponding commission.
tools.eligibility: Manual approval, normally 2-3 business days. Inkfluence says it approves affiliates with a relevant established platform such as a blog, YouTube channel, podcast, newsletter, or active social account; no exclusivity is required.
tools.evidence_summary: Inkfluence AI's official affiliate page was updated in August 2026 and confirms a live Tolt-hosted program with 30% commission, a 12-month recurring window for monthly subscribers, a 30-day cookie, $25 minimum monthly payout, and manual review.

tools.network: FirstPromoter or another affiliate tool specified by Jasper
tools.commission: The still-published Marketing Affiliate Program Agreement states 25% commission on eligible non-enterprise subscription plans for the first 12 months of a referred customer's subscription
tools.eligibility: Current official materials conflict operationally: Jasper still lists a Marketing Affiliate Program Agreement in its 2026 legal center, but that agreement's program-policy URL now resolves to Jasper's Solutions Partner program, which explicitly says independent affiliates and individual promoters are not eligible and targets consultancies, digital agencies, and systems integrators.
tools.evidence_summary: Do not auto-apply yet. Jasper's affiliate legal agreement remains live, but the current program-policy/application surface points to a different Solutions Partner program that excludes independent affiliates. A current affiliate enrollment route must be confirmed before any application action.

tools.commission: 20% of every referred-customer payment, recurring for up to 12 months
tools.payout_terms: Monthly payouts through FirstPromoter. Current official terms state commissions are paid on the first of the month at least 30 days after a referred trial converts to paid, with a $50 minimum due commission threshold.
tools.eligibility: Current official page says most applications are reviewed within 24 hours, with no traffic minimum and no exclusivity/time commitment stated for the standard affiliate program.
tools.evidence_summary: Writesonic's current official affiliate page confirms a live program paying 20% recurring for 12 months with a 60-day last-click cookie, monthly payouts, no referral cap, and a free application flow.

tools.commission: 30% lifetime commission on referred customers' active paid plans, as described by TextCortex's own affiliate materials
tools.eligibility: TextCortex's current partner legal terms require affiliate signup through its Rewardful portal with a valid email address, age 18+, and acceptance of the partner terms.
tools.evidence_summary: TextCortex's official materials continue to advertise its own affiliate program, a 30% lifetime commission model, and an affiliate application route. Exact current cookie duration and payout threshold were not established from the retrieved official material and are left unknown.
